about: Stateful model-based testing (testing.Model, Agrees, AgreesAnd) mutants for PROPERTY-TESTING P4.

mutants.name: model-offer-ignores-state
mutants.rule: Agrees passes the current model state to m.Offer(state) at each step, not m.Start.

mutants.name: model-compares-last-only
mutants.rule: Agrees compares want == got at every step so intermediate transient divergences are caught immediately.

mutants.name: model-diverged-acts-truncated
mutants.from: return Diverged[A, V]{Acts: played, At: step, Want: want, Got: got}
mutants.to: return Diverged[A, V]{Acts: played[0:step], At: step, Want: want, Got: got}
mutants.rule: Diverged.Acts includes the complete prefix up to and including the diverging act at step At so replays reach Want != Got.

mutants.name: model-step-order-swapped
mutants.from:
let (nextState, want) = m.Step(state, a)
		try st.Do(a)
mutants.to:
try st.Do(a)
		let (nextState, want) = m.Step(state, a)
mutants.rule: Agrees steps the pure story model before applying the act to the stage.
